tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, including development builds; it is not turned off for local testing. This sits alongside the recorded decision to enforce https everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

The earlier plan to turn verification off in dev builds was replaced by the "verification on all builds" decision, so the file doesn't mention it.

The Muninn heartbeat is reporting RED, with 20 hook runs started and never finished. I read the two decisions directly with `muninn show`, so this doesn't affect the file. You may still want to look at `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
